recap.text: Donut's boxes turn up a green scroll that clanks like metal, then about twenty more, and Mordecai says Emergency Gremlin is a summoning scroll whose gremlins fix a vehicle mid-race, or a biological mount. Carl reads three more scrolls, and eight bewildered gremlins in overalls appear, one in goggles, one with a hook for a hand. The kangaroo dips two in his pouch and eats more to heal.

beats.headline: Twenty of them
beats.text: Donut's boxes are mostly crappy clothes and healing scrolls until a green scroll clanks heavily onto the table, as if it were made of metal. Emergency Gremlin? The next several boxes hold nothing else, and suddenly she has about twenty. Why does she need so many emergency gremlins? It is a summoning scroll, Mordecai says, like Bautista's toys. They can fix your vehicle if it breaks down mid-race, and this kind can fix biological mounts too. Donut hisses as more appear.
beats.gist: Donut's boxes keep yielding Emergency Gremlin scrolls until she has about twenty, and Mordecai explains they repair vehicles.

beats.headline: Babies for the pouch
beats.text: Prison Pocket wants babies. Carl reads an Emergency Gremlin scroll as Donut reads hers, and he repeats it three more times, and eight bewildered gremlins in overalls stand in the road with their toolboxes, one in goggles, one with one eye, one with a hook for a hand. What're we fixing, boss? The kangaroo dips two in his pouch, and eats more to heal. Carl tries not to feel bad: Imani says they explode when the summoning ends anyway. Afterwards one survivor drops his toolbox on Carl's stomach, tells him to go fuck himself, and times out.
beats.gist: Carl reads four Emergency Gremlin scrolls; the kangaroo pouches two gremlins, and the rest explode or time out.

beats.headline: Word gets round the garage
beats.text: Back in the garage the generated gremlins chitter angrily at Carl, and one flips him off. Donut explains to Hedy that they used some Emergency Gremlin scrolls to distract the boss: a few got dipped in the pouch, a few got eaten, and she wonders how the others even know. To Carl's surprise, Hedy laughs. Serves the little freaks right. They'll still fix the truck true. Probably.
beats.gist: Hedy laughs when Donut admits the Emergency Gremlin scrolls distracted the boss, while the angry gremlins chitter.

beats.headline: Keeping Bruna alive
beats.text: The roof blows, Osvaldo is gone, and he has left a grenade to kill Bruna, his slaughter gnu. The party fires three potion balls at her to save her life: a liquid drop shield, an explosion blanket and a smoke curtain. Donut lands on the gnu and casts her own shield, sprouts trees all round her, and then a half dozen emergency gremlins sprout along the gnu's back. She has already been poisoned, but one of the gremlins is in his toolbox pulling out medicine. They can help biological mounts as well as mechanical ones.
beats.gist: Emergency gremlins sprout along Bruna's back after the party shields her, and one fetches medicine for her poisoning.
